title: X-Ops: The Operator's Manual
author: Field notes for Harsh Kasana
description: How the companion that sits in your X tab actually works and how to run it — the pipeline in PROJECTS/Me/x-ops, why an edit is worth more than a like, the two ledgers that keep it honest, drafting one reply end to end, the relationship layer that turns 'engage and see who engages back' into a real experiment, your own post series, and the rules that never bend no matter how good a draft looks.
